block.comment: ORACLE UPDATED V3: change the numbers in this block before you run the bot. The bot reads the market for you. SIDE: every time a new cycle starts it counts the last digits of the ticks it holds. If digits 0 and 1 are the quietest it plans Over 1. If digits 8 and 9 are the quietest it plans Under 8. ENTRY: Over 1 waits for a 1 and then a higher digit. Under 8 waits for an 8 and then a lower digit. USE LIMIT = 1 also needs the two quiet digits to be each below LIMIT PERCENT (10.5%) of the ticks (at least MIN TICKS). USE LIMIT = 0 trades on the pattern alone. RUNS = how many trades in a row it makes once the pattern shows (3 by default, set any number). Then it stops trading, waits for the next pattern and repeats the cycle until take profit or stop loss. RECOVERY: a loss on Over 1 recovers on Under 6, then on Over 3. A loss on Under 8 recovers on Over 3, then on Under 6. RECOVERY OVER DIGIT = 3 and RECOVERY UNDER DIGIT = 6. The stake is multiplied by MARTINGALE after each loss. When the recovery is over the bot waits for the next pattern. HALT AFTER RECOVERY = 1 stops the bot completely instead. MARTINGALE = the stake multiplier after a loss. MAX STAKE = if a recovery stake would be higher than this the bot goes back to the start. STOP LOSS and TAKE PROFIT = session limits in dollars. Keep MAX RECOVERY at 2. Leave the other variables as they are.
